summary: User-authorized formal MatRIS energy-and-force replay fine-tuning was submitted once to MZ73 as Slurm job 1505. Remote preflight passed all dataset, held-out, runtime, checkpoint, and hash bindings. The job is initially RUNNING and may produce only a non-promoted checkpoint candidate; no path rerun or checkpoint promotion is authorized.

payload.objective: Wait for MZ73 Slurm job 1505 to finish, collect its producer exit record, result, and checkpoint candidate, then review frozen TS held-out and adsorption-retention metrics before any checkpoint promotion or complete-path rerun decision.
current_evidence: MZ73 exposes four RTX 4090 GPUs; the remote preflight observed available memory and the Slurm scheduler selected resources for job 1505.
The frozen base checkpoint SHA-256 is 1e6a85b33db075ad1637eca7537084024a694b1340358911212d8a5c518c6601.
Remote execution-package preflight passed for 30 optimizer samples, 4 adsorption validation samples, and 7 frozen TS held-out samples with zero held-out leakage.
Training uses energy_head, 12 epochs, learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-6, gradient clip 1.0, force weight 1.0, and relative-energy weight 0.05.
Slurm returned job ID 1505 and squeue reported RUNNING on MZ73.
The producer log passed the review-request, execution-authorization, and base-checkpoint SHA-256 checks before training began.
payload.one_executable_step: Monitor job 1505 to queue exit, collect the producer exit record and outputs, and perform work-side checkpoint and retention review; do not automatically retry, promote, or rerun the path.
payload.submission_boundary: Exactly one formal fine-tuning candidate run is authorized and submitted. Automatic retry, checkpoint promotion, complete MatRIS path rerun, AQCat25 returned-path audit, VASP micro-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, and barrier reporting remain unauthorized.
done_when: Job 1505 reaches queue exit and its producer exit record is collected.
The result and checkpoint candidate hashes are verified and the checkpoint reloads with finite parameters.
Frozen TS held-out force/relative-energy metrics and adsorption-retention metrics are reviewed against the base checkpoint.
A separate checkpoint-promotion or rejection decision is recorded; any complete-path rerun requires new authorization.
